title: Compose the Billing futures, do not block

task.text: Each `Billing` pipeline parks a pool thread on `get()` while it waits for the next stage.
Rebuild `summary`, `pair` and `summaryOrFallback` as pure `CompletableFuture` compositions. Results and failures must stay the same.

items: Keep `Billing(Executor io)`, `userName`, `balance` and the three method signatures, each returning a `CompletableFuture<String>`.
No `get()` or `join()` inside the three methods.
Lookups that do not depend on each other must be submitted together.
Everything must still work on an executor with one thread.

checks.title: A failed lookup fails the future
No stage blocks with get or join

hints.text: A pipeline that blocks on `get()` holds a thread idle and, on a small pool, can wait for a task that no thread is free to run. Instead of waiting for a value, say what to do when it arrives.

Use `thenCompose` when the next stage returns a future (`balance` needs the user), `thenCombine` for two independent futures, and `exceptionally` to turn a failure into a value. Each method becomes one expression.
